title: Vendor Analytics — Order Fulfilment
description: Powers the Order fulfilment status cards. Counts orders created in the selected calendar year by current status. An order belongs to exactly one bucket.

endpoint.auth: Vendor Bearer token + Application-Token (same as other /api/vendor/* routes)

query.year: YYYY. Required. Calendar year. Frontend defaults to the current year.

fields.total: Sum of the four status counts. All orders created that year, not only completed sales.
fields.pending: Not yet delivered, cancelled, or returned.
